observations: Photo 0 shows a used internal combustion engine assembly on the floor/stand with visible grime and wear.
A label/tag on the engine cover appears to show text including '2ZR' (partially readable).
No clear readable brand/model plate, engine code details, or mileage are visible.
No photo of the engine running, compression test, or leak checks.

claims.claim: Direct America very neet and tested ok
claims.evidence: Photo 0 only shows the engine externally; there is no running video, test sheet, or clear proof of testing.
No written warranty terms or proof of guarantee are shown in the photos or seller text.

risks.risk: Engine code/variant may not match what the buyer needs (photo is unclear; only partial '2ZR' is visible). Wrong engine code can make it unusable.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate and the full stamped code on the block/head (not just the cover), plus the VIN/vehicle it came from.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used engine with unknown exact code/fitment.

risks.risk: Condition may be worse than claimed (external dirt/wear; no evidence of compression, leak-down, or overheating history).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the engine cranking and running (cold start if possible) and a compression test result screenshot/photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/possibly needing work.

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incomplete kit (alternator, starter, sensors, intake/exhaust components) can increase cost to complete the swap.
risks.proof: Ask for a checklist photo showing included parts (starter, alternator, ECU, sensors, intake manifold, exhaust manifold, belts/hoses) laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine-only / incomplete until confirmed.

risks.risk: Leakage (oil/coolant) and head gasket issues can’t be confirmed from a single still photo.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the engine after a test run showing no leaks, plus a close-up of the oil pan area and coolant passages.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may have leaks/needs reseal.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the full engine code/ID stamped on the block/head (and any label) to confirm exact variant.
Video: engine cranking and running (ideally cold start) with sound and stable idle.
Compression test or leak-down test result (photo/screenshot).
Photo checklist of included accessories/parts (what exactly comes with the engine).
Warranty proof: written terms or a message screenshot stating what the 3-month guarantee covers.
response.reason: The photos show a used engine but do not provide reliable proof of the exact engine code, testing status, or completeness; without that, a safe worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the comparables.
